QUOTE: `scripts/generate_errors.pl` scans every `include/mbedtls/*.h` for `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_\w+ -0x...` lines. It emits a `case -(NAME): return "MODULE - description";` line for each one into `scripts/data_files/error.fmt`, and writes the result to `library/error.c`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states error.c is generated from the public headers by generate_errors.pl using error.fmt as the template (emits into error.fmt, writes error.c), and says not to hand-edit it.
